title: Mothwing Oud
history: A moth rosette guards the spruce face. A new dark rib interrupts the old bowl.

title: Courier’s Nyckelharpa
history: Waxed maple keys run under a split rail secured with two brass staples.

title: Rain-Chart Koto
history: Thirteen ivory-coloured bridges cast long shadows across a rain-marked board.

title: Ferryman’s Kora
history: The hide carries two lines of old tacks beside the ferryman’s brass tally rings.

title: Heather Mountain Dulcimer
history: A copper swallow and two heart-shaped ports flank a polished melody rail.

title: Root Lantern
history: A split above the root end has been lashed shut beneath a small moon charm.

title: Cloud Stair Siku
history: Woven red bindings hold mismatched replacement cane in two answering ranks.

title: Reed Citadel
history: A dark windchest carries a little skyline of reed towers and gilt pipe shoes.

title: Night-Watch Pipes
history: The oxblood bag has a stitched patch. Three collared drones share its stock.

title: Vesper Serpent
history: Copper splints follow the leathered bends. The bell bears a repaired lip.

title: Orchard Balafon
history: Individually tied slats sit over wax-rimmed buzzing gourds.

title: Bottle-Star Mbira
history: Thumb-polished tongues share the board with a row of loose bottle-cap buzzers.

title: Caravan Tabla
history: Replacement tuning blocks sit under stretched straps. Each skin carries a dark loading patch.

title: Tide-Clock Kulintang
history: Eight bossed gongs hang on a cord bed. Their patina breaks at the worn striking spots.

title: River-Mouth Udu
history: A pale slip spiral winds past the side port and a laced repair at the shoulder.

title: Frostvein Fiddle
history: Four understrings disappear beneath the board. A leaf scroll rises from its pegbox.

title: Candlewheel Gurdy
history: A patched wheel cover leaves the rosined rim and eccentric crank visible.

title: Tideglass Armonica
history: Sea-green nested rims share a brass axle with a chipped flywheel.

title: Quayside Bandoneon
history: Worn button caps and copper corner guards flank a patched wine-red bellows.

title: Eclipse Handpan
history: Hammer scars surround seven blue-black tone fields and a bright central dome.

title: Magnetar Flux Organ
history: Verdigris creeps under three wound field coils. Their armatures still turn.

title: Periapsis Ribbon
history: A ceramic shuttle rides a polished copper ribbon between two calibration stops.

title: Vacuum Choir
history: Amber cathodes glow through smoked envelopes. One valve wears a replacement cage.

title: Cryotape Echoplex
history: Spliced oxide tape crosses three heads beneath a frost-scarred coolant reservoir.

title: Pulsar Navigation Loom
history: Punched brass stars pass a reader lamp. A mended drive belt keeps the chart in time.
